revisionReason: Correct played appearances with printed 00:00 minutes; show means consistent with calibrated probabilities; strengthen exact-fixture matching. Prior version and diagnostics retained under audits/2026-10-19-ev/baseline.
participationPolicy: An official played row remains an appearance even when minutes print 00:00. DNP rows remain excluded. No recorded positive exposure withholds a forecast.
tailPolicy: Withhold thresholds outside the calibration grid and exact-line samples with fewer than five historical wins or losses. Withhold projected role changes.
interpretation: The corrected season was already inspected. Later-date results are diagnostic, not an untouched live track record. Historical pregame injuries, announced lineups, and FanDuel prices are unavailable. Probabilities are conditional on participation. DNP and other voids follow the specific sportsbook contract; no historical ROI is inferred. Prior-season transfer and live role adjustments remain unvalidated. Existing Parlay weights, scores, targets, and research protocol are unchanged.
